title: Anton and Letters
statementMd:
Recently, Anton has found a set. The set consists of small English letters. Anton carefully wrote out all the letters from the set in one line, separated by a comma. He also added an opening curved bracket at the beginning of the line and a closing curved bracket at the end of the line.

Unfortunately, from time to time Anton would forget writing some letter and write it again. He asks you to count the total number of distinct letters in his set.

## Input

The first and the single line contains the set of letters. The length of the line doesn't exceed 1000. It is guaranteed that the line starts from an opening curved bracket and ends with a closing curved bracket. Between them, small English letters are listed, separated by a comma. Each comma is followed by a space.

## Output

Print a single number — the number of distinct letters in Anton's set.
statementZhMd:
最近，安东发现了一个集合。这个集合由小写英文字母组成。安东仔细地将集合中的所有字母用逗号分隔，写在一行中。他还在行首添加了一个左花括号，在行末添加了一个右花括号。

遗憾的是，安东有时会忘记写下某个字母，有时又会重复写下它。他请你统计集合中不同字母的总数。

## 输入格式

第一行也是唯一一行，包含这个字母集合。该行长度不超过 1000。保证该行以左花括号开头，以右花括号结尾。两者之间列出若干小写英文字母，并用逗号分隔。每个逗号后面都有一个空格。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——安东的集合中不同字母的数量。
